description: Return the bound spend key’s hard limits: label, per-transaction max in USD, daily cap, optional seller allowlist, expiry, and authMode (oauth or vapt). Use this to tell the user what the agent is allowed to request before calling pay_offering. Related: get_spend_balance, get_wallet_balance.

inputSchema.description: This tool takes no arguments. Authenticate with OAuth (Claude Sign in) or Authorization: Bearer vapt_… (Cursor).
inputSchema.title: NoArguments

name: get_limits

outputSchema.description: Hard policy limits on the bound spend key (OAuth or Bearer VAPT).

allowedSellerUsernames.description: If non-empty, pay_offering may only target these Collect seller usernames.

clientName.description: OAuth client name when authMode is oauth.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when this key expires, or null if it does not.

label.description: Owner-chosen name for this key, e.g. Laptop agent.

remainingDailyUsd.description: Headroom left today under the daily cap.

outputSchema.title: SpendLimits

title: Get spend limits
